theme: A slow canal boat drifting through a fog-bound lowland at first light, lock by lock, until the sun clears the mist.
working_title: Fog Canal at Dawn | 45 min Slow Drift for Focus
alternate_titles: Canal Boat Through the Morning Fog | 45 min Ambient
First Light on the Lowland Canal | 45 min Focus Ambience

scenes.name: Mooring in fog
scenes.visual_description: A narrow canal boat tied at a stone quay, seen from the towpath at water level. Dense white fog, the far bank invisible, a single lantern on the bow glowing warm. Reeds in the foreground, water like grey glass.
scenes.motion: Fog drifts left to right very slowly; lantern flickers; faint ripples from a drop.
scenes.transition_out: slow dissolve as the rope slips from the bollard

scenes.name: Casting off
scenes.visual_description: View from the stern looking forward along the boat roof, fog thinning slightly to show pollarded willows on both banks. Wake spreading behind in a soft V.
scenes.motion: Slow forward drift; willows pass at walking pace; wake ripples.
scenes.transition_out: match cut on the water surface

scenes.name: The first lock
scenes.visual_description: Inside a brick lock chamber, wet walls dark with moss, gates ahead closed, water rising. Fog lit from above, no people visible.
scenes.motion: Water level rises across the scene; drips fall from the gate timbers.
scenes.transition_out: gates swing open and the frame brightens

scenes.name: Open water
scenes.visual_description: A wide reach of canal with the fog lifting into bands, a heron standing in the shallows, a distant windmill silhouette softly visible.
scenes.motion: Fog bands rise; heron shifts weight once; boat drifts.

scenes.name: Under the bridge
scenes.visual_description: Passing beneath a low brick arch, reflections of rippling light on the underside of the bridge, the far opening bright.
scenes.motion: Caustic light patterns move on the brick; the bright opening grows.
scenes.transition_out: emerging into light, exposure ramps up

scenes.name: Sun through mist
scenes.visual_description: Low sun breaking through the last of the mist over flat fields beside the canal, long shadows from a line of poplars, dew on grass in the foreground.
scenes.motion: Sun glow intensifies slowly; mist thins; dew sparkles.

scenes.name: The village reach
scenes.visual_description: Canal-side cottages with slate roofs and closed shutters, smoke from one chimney, a rowing boat tied to a post, morning light warm and clear.
scenes.motion: Chimney smoke drifts; boat drifts past at the same slow pace.

scenes.name: Mooring in sun
scenes.visual_description: The boat tied at a quiet quay in full morning sun, a kettle on the stern, ripples settling. The frame holds, then fades to black over the last 30 seconds.
scenes.motion: Ripples settle; very slight lens breathing; fade to black.

instrumentation: field texture: distant water, rope creak
audio_brief.dynamics_over_time: Very soft for the first 10 minutes, a slow rise through the lock and open water, a warm plateau from the sun scene, tapering to the drone alone for the last two minutes.

structure_by_scene.change: everything but the drone leaves; fade

audio_brief.generation_prompt: Slow ambient piece in F Lydian, no drums, bowed bass drone with soft felt piano and glassy pads, gradual brightening over 45 minutes, gentle water and rope textures, no melody hooks, suitable for focus.

visual_style.medium: painterly photoreal with soft film grain
visual_style.camera_language: Locked-off or drifting at walking pace, water-level or stern height, no handheld, no zooms.
visual_style.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, people, faces, boats with brand names, modern signage, cars, blur artefacts
visual_style.generation_prompt_prefix: Painterly photoreal lowland canal at dawn, soft fog, muted greens and warm lantern amber, fine film grain, cinematic 16:9, no people, no text --

variation_rationale: Recent videos were an interior cabin, a night sky, and a rain study. This is a journey format with forward motion through connected locations, a cool grey-green palette instead of amber/indigo/glass-green, and a drone-based audio structure rather than piano-led or synth pads.

compliance_checklist.notes: Windmill and cottages are generic, not a named landmark.

assumptions: audio_source undecided: the generation_prompt works as a brief to a composer or as a prompt to a music generator.
visual_source undecided: scenes are written as stills-with-motion; a licensed loop library would need matching footage per scene.
